Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1135
Claimant:
Jon Ellis
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
10/07/2023
Claim opened after a rear-end collision reported by the insured's driver, who is named on the policy. The claimant
reports neck pain and has not retained a lawyer.
10/20/2023
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the accident happened as described, and the other driver's
account matches. Photos of the rear bumper are on file.
11/10/2023
Police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact. Claimant gave a statement that is
consistent with the initial report.
11/15/2023
Reviewed the vehicle's prior repair history. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing suggests the
damage predates the start of coverage.
11/20/2023
Claimant was seen at urgent care the same day and diagnosed with whiplash. The reported injury is plausible for a
crash of this type.
12/01/2023
Claimant described the same account of the collision in every conversation so far. No changes to the timeline or
sequence have come up.
12/11/2023
Claimant's records show a minor strain in the same neck area several years ago, which healed fully according to the
prior provider notes.
01/22/2024
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. Requested a updated treatment plan and records
from the treating clinic.
02/07/2024
Clinic records are received. Physical therapy visits continue, and the notes describe gradual improvement with some
ongoing stiffness.
02/23/2024
Reviewed the damage estimate against the photos. It is not clear yet whether all of the claimed damage came from
this impact, so the question is open.
04/15/2024
Sent a request to the medical reviewer to assess how much of the current treatment relates to this collision, given the
earlier strain.
04/19/2024
File remains open pending the medical reviewer's opinion on causation and the final treatment update from the clinic.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
